paper.title: Regular Layout Optimization for Offshore Wind Farms Considering Seabed Terrains and Turbulence Intensity
paper.authors: Zehai Huang and Yunfei Du and Renshen Tan and Xinwei Shen

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: target paper and first-party patent found; exact-title DOI method author institution and GitHub searches found no target source, Gurobi model, private arrays, layouts, traces or result archive

paper_source_conflicts: Table I labels 155/90/263m as rotor radius, but turbine identity, 5D spacing and figures require the diameter interpretation.
Eqs.13-14 omit upstream selection x_i, and Eqs.12/51 omit target selection; the printed forms violate source-target placement semantics.
Eq.43 omits wind-scenario probabilities although probability weighting is required by the stated expected-fatigue meaning and Table IV scale.
Eq.29's discounted multi-year AEP conflicts with annualized costs and the reported LCOE scale.
Table IX prose reports 1530/7237s, whereas Table IX reports 5530/16237s; the table controls.
missing_information: target author source, Gurobi model/settings and numerical archive
exact Zhuhai and Hainan boundaries, depth arrays and soil/rock rasters
wind direction, speed and probability arrays
the ten exact start-column and gap pattern pairs
BDA tolerance, iteration cap and original solution coordinates
completion_decisions: Retain all 31 unique deterministic paper-native target roles; comparison-only GA, PSO and GWO are excluded.
Interpret Table I dimensions as rotor diameters and enforce the literal 5D separation.
Restore source-target selection in wake and TI, probability-weight TI fatigue, and use annual expected energy consistently.
Use analytic site, terrain and sixteen-sector wind proxies for unavailable private arrays.
Generate the first ten safety-valid start/gap pairs separately for every grid resolution.
Use BDA tolerance1e-6, at most20 iterations and the paper's 10000-second formal per-subproblem ceiling.
Use pinned HiGHS with presolve disabled after isolated false-infeasibility evidence and independently evaluate every incumbent.
Run each HiGHS task with one thread and parallelize independent angle-pattern tasks over the persistent full-core executor.
